arms.B4X_FITTED_UNTYPED_UNIT_SIGN_LEARNED_CON: V1's comparator, refitted by V1's own fit_signs on V2's development split. THE CAPACITY CONTROL: learned and information-matched, class {-1,0,+1} with 0 unreachable in practice.

fitting_procedures.B6_GREEDY_SUBSET_UNTYPED: forward selection over (channel, weight in {-2,-1,+1}); unselected channels weigh exactly 0; accept only on a STRICT improvement in development capability accuracy; tie-break by higher accuracy, then smaller |weight|, then channel order in CHANNELS, then weight order (+1,-1,-2); at most 16 rounds; no RNG
fitting_procedures.B7_L1_PATH_UNTYPED: L1-penalised least squares by cyclic coordinate descent, zero initialisation, 5000 iterations, tol 1e-10; lambda grid = lambda_max * 10**(-j*6/24) for j in 0..24; two registered feature scalings RAW and STANDARDIZED (development-split standard deviations); select by development capability accuracy, ties to the LARGER lambda then RAW; |w| < 1e-9 reported and scored as exactly 0; no RNG

comparator.selection_rule: B8 = whichever of B6/B7 has the higher development capability accuracy; exact tie to B6
comparator.why_no_published_method_parent: ME-X6's generator emits per-period integer channel counts and no bibliographic objects -- no papers, reference lists, citation edges, author records or venues. No published science-of-science estimator is natively computable on that input, so no parent-fidelity receipt of the ME-X1 kind is possible, and none is manufactured. See ME_X6_COMPARATOR_PROVENANCE_AND_NON_FIDELITY_RECEIPT_V1.md section 2. The comparator is named for what it is: a learned capacity-matched untyped aggregate.

gates.note: Every gate is a POSITIVE test with its own n_evaluated. G1b (tie) is registered as its own positive test -- equal totals AND zero discordant pairs -- and is NOT the negation of G1a.

out_of_scope: any change to a V1 gate, number, terminal or authorization

predecessor.open_question_v1_could_not_answer: V1 established that a HAND-SET zeroing recovers the conjunction. Whether a LEARNED capacity-matched parent ties M was never measured.
predecessor.status: IMMUTABLE -- not edited, not re-run, not re-fitted by this study

question: V1's comparator learns one weight per channel in {-1,0,+1} by univariate marginal screening; a 0 arises only from an exact tie, so it cannot in practice drop a channel. Information matching held; CAPACITY matching did not. Does an untyped comparator whose weight class CONTAINS zero, and which is FITTED rather than hand-set, reproduce M's capability verdict at matched information?

reachability_audit_pre_run.a_clause_the_comparator_is_AHEAD_of_M_is: M is exact by construction on this generator (V1 design 1.3), so such a clause would be unreachable -- a gate that could not fire. The two live outcomes are the tie (G1b) and M-ahead (G1a).
reachability_audit_pre_run.both_fitters_are_heuristics_that_can_mis: demonstrated on constructed datasets in the selftest: forward selection reaches 5/6 where the hidden in-class rule reaches 6/6; the lasso path reaches 6/8 where the same hidden rule reaches 8/8. An EXHAUSTIVE search over a class containing M's vector was deliberately NOT registered, because it could not fail and a tie would then be an identity rather than a measurement.
reachability_audit_pre_run.the_comparator_class_contains_a_FAILING_: all-+1 weights score 28/56 on the development split
reachability_audit_pre_run.the_protected_seed_governs_instance_gene: the comparator fit is a deterministic, RNG-free function of the PUBLIC development split and is frozen before the protected seed is revealed. Stated because a seed that does nothing to a parameter, left unstated, is a defect.

scored_half.activity: NOT SCORED AND NOT REPORTED. V1 computes the activity direction from the activity channels by the same call for every arm, so an activity agreement is equal BY CONSTRUCTION and is not evidence (V1 provenance receipt section 3). Publishing it would be a contrast that could not exist.

seed_commitment.note: The seed value is published in the outcome receipt AFTER the run. Custody file ~/.orion-custody/me-x6-v2/PROTECTED_SEED_V1.txt.

terminals.NONE: route CANNOT_CHECK -- a hard gate did not pass, or neither live clause holds as registered.
terminals.TYPING_NOT_SEPARATED_AT_MATCHED_CAPACITY: route PARENT_SUFFICIENT. A learned untyped comparator whose class contains zero reproduces M's capability verdict on every instance. ME-X6's separation is attributable to comparator CAPACITY, not to typing. This is the protocol's registered contraction and a LEGITIMATE result, not a failure.

title: Does a LEARNED capacity-matched untyped comparator recover ME-X6's conjunction?
